facts.fact: Prime Minister Majaliwa praised e-GA's use of local experts to build government ICT systems and awarded 15 e-GA ICT officers who took part in building GovESB, on 23 June 2025.
e-GA is reported as having built GovESB, which more than 180 public institutions have joined to exchange data across government.

note: Go-live date of GovESB not stated, so no built-and-live fact.
